descriptions.subject: marlroot
descriptions.text:
You see a marlroot.
Growth: ripe. Harvest this crop by hand; its produce and saved seed remain here to pick up. The prepared bed can be planted again.

Knuckled roots grip a clod of fine red clay tightly enough to bring it up when pulled. The planted crop takes 52 moist rounds in this area to become ripe. Harvest by hand, then pick up its marlroot clod and one saved seed. Choose Prepare in inventory to separate one clod into fire clay for repairing clay-lined masonry.
